children: US T-cell immunotherapy developer's Q3 revenue fell yr/yr but beat analyst expectations
Company narrowed Q3 net loss compared to prior year
Operating expenses declined sharply, reflecting ongoing cost-reduction efforts
Atara expects operating expenses to decline significantly year-over-year in 2026
Company anticipates cash and investments will fund operations into mid-2027
FDA sets March 31, 2027 target action date for tab-cel BLA
REVENUE DECLINE - Co said lower Q3 revenue was primarily due to a one-time sale of clinical inventory in the prior year
COST REDUCTION - Co attributed significant decline in operating expenses to cost-reduction initiatives implemented in 2025 and early 2026
The current average analyst rating on the shares is "buy" and the breakdown of recommendations is 3 "strong buy" or "buy", 1 "hold" and no "sell" or "strong sell"
The average consensus recommendation for the biotechnology & medical research peer group is "buy"
Wall Street's median 12-month price target for Atara Biotherapeutics, Inc. is $13.00, about 58.9% above its November 9 closing price of $8.18
The stock recently traded at 43 times the next 12-month earnings vs. a P/E of 363 three months ago
